_how_to_use: Add an entry to notes to have it appear on the Knowledge base tab. Each entry needs id, kind (decision | note | limit), date, title, text and evidence (the file, commit or test that shows it). No evidence, no entry.

notes.title: Frontend uses Vite, not Create React App
notes.text: Create React App is deprecated upstream and pulls a heavier dependency tree than a walking skeleton needs. The output is still React and TypeScript.

notes.title: The NHS ingest tool returns at most 20 records per call
notes.text: nhs-ops-status caps the limit argument at 20 on the server, so the real-data decision cycle was proved at 20 ICBs. Volume beyond that is covered by a synthetic 50-ICB test only.

notes.title: Trust-log writes are serialised in-process
notes.text: Concurrent writes to one FileTrustLogger broke the hash chain. Writes now queue so the chain stays valid when the decision cycle ingests sources in parallel.
